selection.install_command: (type -p wget >/dev/null || (sudo apt update && sudo apt install wget -y)) && sudo mkdir -p -m 755 /etc/apt/keyrings && out=$(mktemp) && wget -nv -O$out https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg && cat $out | sudo tee /etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg > /dev/null && sudo chmod go+r /etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg && sudo mkdir -p -m 755 /etc/apt/sources.list.d && echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list > /dev/null && sudo apt update && sudo apt install gh -y

layers.deciding_comparison: The definite install set is Git, worktrunk and gh, plus one unresolved structural-diff finalist. On clean WSL2 Ubuntu x86_64, compare sem and Difftastic on independently labeled moves, renames, formatting-only edits, nested changes, malformed code and large files; measure missed changes, false structural changes, agent interpretation accuracy, latency and memory. Compare worktrunk with native Git on concurrent worktree creation, cleanup and interrupted-operation recovery. Qualify gh with an actual create/check/review/merge lifecycle, including publication and failure recovery. Before adding the Codex bridge, test the exact bridge version against direct Codex review for seeded-defect recall, false positives and review-gate recovery. Repeat installation and core correctness on macOS arm64. The packet contains no completed all-arm comparisons.
evidence_gaps: Currency was judged against 2026-07-03 through 2026-10-01. All seven distinct repositories have a qualifying default-branch commit and none is archived.
Linux artifacts support WSL2 suitability by inference; no clean target-host installation or benchmark was executed. None of these roles requires the RTX 4090.
sem and Difftastic are tied alternatives, not a recommendation to install both. Comparative correctness and agent usefulness remain unresolved.

sem's default-branch README postdates v0.25.0; MCP/JSON feature parity at that release was not fully verified. Its repository description and README disagree on language count, so no exact count is asserted.
Only gh has an independently observed successful CI run here. Worktrunk's test count is commit-reported; other inspected test badges and commit reports are not equivalent to verified CI results.
Git releases/latest returned HTTP 404; this does not establish an absence of upstream releases. Git's latest release date and macOS arm64-specific evidence remain unverified.
Specific issue-response and resolution activity was not measured. Open issue/PR counts were not treated as maintenance-quality scores. Future-dated repository updated_at fields were disregarded.
No paid-service exclusion was justified: the Codex bridge documents Free-account authentication, while the Action's service-cost eligibility remained unverified.
Budget used: 30 GitHub API calls, 6 web searches, 7 attempted page fetches and 0 successful page fetches.

The requested ctx_fetch_and_index action was rejected with 'MCP tool call requires approval, but approval policy is never'. Consequently, the requested fetch/index/search workflow could not be completed; README evidence came through GitHub API and additional documentation through primary-source search excerpts.
